propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan project criteria into Pass 1 discovery, blocking new LLM-backed project criteria from executing in Round-A
Project criteria routing is plan-review-biased and the code-review eval/CLI surface cannot resolve diff-based eval specs for project-owned criteria
Pass 3 routing does not consistently apply repository-effective threshold, posture, and nit-suppression values for project criteria

A project criterion must maintain strict phase boundaries: Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 validates existing findings, Pass 3 applies deterministic rules, and Pass 4 provides non-prescriptive guidance without re-adjudication

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion requires a balanced eval corpus discriminating valid phase-compliant findings (RP-F1..RP-F6) from invalid cross-phase violations (RP-N1..RP-N6) with minimum kappa 0.70 and 1.0 recall before live dogfooding

Live Gerrit evidence must capture both valid positive-control advisory findings and invalid cross-phase directives, with invalid directives removed before submission to establish operational phase separation
